text_981875711_copy.text: Through close collaboration with leading surgeons, we have a well-earned reputation as a market leader for our innovative developments in craniomaxillofacial and neurosurgery. In order to maintain this spirit of innovation and leadership, we continuously focus our research and development in the following categories.

text.text:
Cranial

As a market leader, our innovative access, intervention and closure solutions for neurosurgery to support efficiency and positive surgical outcomes for the surgeons and patients we serve.

Learn more

Aesthetics

Having trusted products and service is a critical component of performing aesthetic surgery. Our MEDPOR implants and Colorado Needles are part of a broad portfolio designed to support your work. Combined with our dedicated service, we’re committed to helping you keep your business running smoothly.

Learn more

Orthognathic

Correcting skeletal irregularities is a big deal in a patient’s life, and we offer a complete portfolio of products to support you. Our planning and surgical tools along with our 2D and 3D plates provide you the utmost confidence to plan and execute each case, so that you’re well equipped with the tools to do your heroic work.

Learn more

Reconstruction

Your facial reconstruction cases take herculean time, skill and dedication. From virtual pre-planning, to placing the final screw into a patient specific plate, we are alongside you every step of the way to help make your case as seamless as possible. Our products combined with our high-quality service provide an unmatched level of assurance for your entire perioperative experience.

Learn more

Trauma

Stryker’s facial trauma products are the #1 most chosen products for facial trauma cases.¹ Our German-engineered products have a long history of quality and reliability and are backed by unparalleled service - attributes we believe are paramount in helping you achieve the best outcomes for your patients.

Learn more

largeheadline.line2:
Our commitment to education & training:

 

At Stryker, we never forget that everything we hope to do for patients depends on the skills and experience of the medical professionals who use our products. Our goal is your success. From post-graduate to practice, we offer training for you every step of the way.

text.text: LEARN MORE ▸

iD Portal

An updated system, for a better experience

We are excited to introduce iD Portal 4.0, our newest upgrade to this digital platform. This unique tool will continue to support the workflow for all patient-specific product requests, while enhancing pre-existing features. From case initiation, to shipment, iD Portal provides real-time updates to case details and allows direct collaboration between health care professionals and Stryker. The iD Portal continues to offer a secure method to transmit and access case data quickly and efficiently.

Let’s build a partnership

Contact a sales rep and learn all the ways we can empower you. Whether it’s a product question, a webinar request or help finding your Stryker rep, we’re here to support you.

Be in the know

Engage with us on our socials to find information.
